newsitem.title: USA: Bear Stearns Q1 revs rise in three areas.
newsitem.headline: Bear Stearns Q1 revs rise in three areas.

text.p: Bear Stearns Cos Inc said Wednesday its revenues in the areas of commissions, principal transactions and investment banking were all up for this year's first quarter.

Commission revenues for the period were $161.6 million compared with $155.2 million for the same quarter in 1995. The increase was attributed to its institutional equities and securities clearance revenues.

Revenues from principal transactions were $294.9 million for the quarter versus $269.9 million for the 1995 first quarter. Bear Stearns said improvement in the segment's fixed income activities, particularly mortgage-backed securities, contributed to the increase.

Investment banking revenues stood at $108.7 million compared with $87.4 million for the same period in the prior year, the company said. The company said the quarter's results reflect increases in equity underwriting and high yield debt issuance.
